Yes, the protestor may be prosecuted. Dumping the trash may be expressive conduct, but the ordinance bans littering regardless of message, so it is content-neutral and serves a substantial interest in clean parks that is unrelated to suppressing speech (*United States v. O'Brien*). The note's rationale that littering is "conduct, not speech" is imprecise, since conduct can be expressive, but the conclusion still holds because the incidental burden on expression is justified.

CONFIDENCE: 70
